Why go: room for a group, and five ways to use the boat

Madam C is a 40 ft sailing catamaran with a base price that covers up to 15 guests, and hotel transfer is included. That makes it one of the best-value group boats on Samui. Kayaks, a paddle board, snorkel gear and fishing gear are carried on every trip.

The full day takes in the islands south of Samui. You start at Koh Madsum (Pig Island), snorkel at Koh Tan, stop at Koh Tan's beach for an optional BBQ lunch, then sail past the Five Islands, with their swiftlet-nest cliffs, to Koh Rap's long, quiet beach. The other four trips are shorter: a sunset cruise, a half day of swimming and snorkelling, a night-fishing trip for squid and reef fish, and a dolphin-watching trip.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: groups of 8–30, families travelling together, and anyone who wants transfer included without adding it up separately.
  • Choose something else if: you want the dolphins as part of a set shared day. Our Pink Dolphins and Pig Island tour is priced per person. Couples will find a smaller boat such as the Aloha better value.

Good to know

  • Dolphins: sightings are likely but never guaranteed. Calm mornings give the best chance.
  • Cash: bring small notes for the Koh Madsum and Koh Rap fees.
  • Night fishing: bring a light jacket and insect repellent. Evenings on the water feel cooler than on land.
  • Kayaks and boards: they are carried on every trip, so pack swimwear even for the sunset cruise.
  • Season: the south coast is sheltered from the October–December north-east wind, so this boat runs more often than north-coast boats in the monsoon.
